MOTIVATION
•Path planning in dense environments is challenging for an
asymmetric rectangular robot.
•Existing planning methods are either conservative, aggressive,
or computationally expensive due to a large search space.

FRAMEWORK
•The overall framework consists of two stages: the mapping
and the planning stage.
•Mapping: We decompose the environment into a quadtree
and generate a RoA-Map, indicating the RoA in each cell.
•Planning: We develop an A* algorithm for RoA-based graph,
which regards nodes as RoAs and edges as feasible motions
between two RoAs.

Simulation
Real-world
•Our method demonstrates fast, accurate, and safe navigation
even in highly cluttered and narrow spaces.
•Our method enables AiDIN-VIII to achieve robust navigation
across various real-world scenarios.
